description: This file defines the VoiceWakeForwarder enum which contains methods and types related to forwarding voice wake-up transcripts, constructing messages, handling errors, and communicating with a gateway connection.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: An enum representing errors in voice wake forwarding, conforming to LocalizedError and Equatable.

classes.name: ForwardOptions
classes.description: A struct to hold options for forwarding, including session key, thinking level, delivery flag, destination, and channel.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Constructs a prefixed string including machine name and the transcript, providing context for voice recognition.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forwarding of the transcript to a gateway asynchronously, returning success or error.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the status of the gateway connection asynchronously.
